speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome, I am Dr. Agent. You mentioned a longstanding pruritic rash with numbness and tingling on your palms; to begin, has this rash appeared symmetrically on both hands, and does it change color or texture, such as becoming red or scaly?

speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Acral Dermatitis of Farmers (also known as Farmers' Prurigo or a specific hypersensitivity reaction to pesticides/fungi). The combination of a longstanding pruritic rash on the upper body/face, bilateral palmar paresthesia (numbness/tingling), and occupational exposure to rice farming and livestock strongly suggests an immune-mediated or hypersensitivity reaction to environmental agents like pesticides or fungi, which can also affect peripheral nerves.
